meta.subject: English
meta.note: محتوى تفاعلي منظم من فهرس كتاب الوزارة الرسمي، مع نطق إنجليزي وأنشطة لمس وتتبع ورسم مناسبة لعمر الطفل.

records.title: Greetings: Hello and Goodbye
records.content: Learn to greet people politely. Say Hello, Hi, Good morning, and Goodbye. Use a friendly voice and a wave when you meet or leave a friend.
records.arabic: نتعلم التحية بطريقة مهذبة: Hello وHi وGood morning، ونقول Goodbye عند المغادرة.
records.activity: Tap each phrase to hear it, then choose the picture that shows meeting a friend.
records.question: What do we say when we meet a friend in the morning?
records.speak: Hello! Hi! Good morning! Goodbye!

records.title: Boy, Girl and Friends
records.content: Use the words boy, girl, and friends to talk about people. We can say: I am a boy. I am a girl. We are friends.
records.arabic: نستخدم كلمات boy وgirl وfriends للتعريف بالنفس والتحدث عن الأصدقاء.
records.activity: Tap the boy or girl picture, listen, and repeat the sentence.
records.question: Complete: We are ...
records.speak: I am a boy. I am a girl. We are friends.

records.title: Happy or Sad?
records.content: Talk about feelings with happy and sad. Look at the face and say how the child feels: I am happy. I am sad.
records.arabic: نتعرف على المشاعر happy وsad ونعبر عن شعورنا بجملة بسيطة.
records.activity: Tap the face that matches the word you hear, then make the same face.
records.question: How do you feel when you play with friends?
records.speak: Happy. Sad. I am happy. I am sad.

records.title: Phonics: Tt
records.content: The letter Tt has the /t/ sound. Listen and repeat: toys, turtle, train. Trace uppercase T and lowercase t from top to bottom.
records.arabic: حرف Tt يصدر صوت /t/، ومن كلماته toys وturtle وtrain.
records.activity: Tap Tt to hear the sound, match the pictures, and trace Tt on the drawing board.
records.question: Which word starts with /t/: turtle or apple?
records.speak: The sound of Tt: /t/. Toys. Turtle. Train.

records.title: Phonics: Ii
records.content: The letter Ii has the /ɪ/ sound in these beginner words: in, insect, ink. Listen carefully and trace uppercase I and lowercase i.
records.arabic: حرف Ii يظهر في كلمات in وinsect وink، ونستمع إلى الصوت ثم نتتبع الحرف.
records.activity: Tap the insect, listen to the word, and trace Ii with your finger.
records.question: Which word starts with Ii: ink or sun?
records.speak: The sound of Ii: /ɪ/. In. Insect. Ink.

records.title: Math and Art: Number 1, Circle and Red
records.content: Recognize number 1, the circle shape, and the red color. Find one object, touch a circle, and color it red.
records.arabic: نتعرف على العدد 1 والشكل الدائري واللون الأحمر من خلال اللمس والتلوين.
records.activity: Tap one object, circle the round object, and color the circle red.
records.question: How many circles do you see?
records.speak: Number one. Circle. Red.

records.title: Unit 1 Practice
records.content: Practice greeting a friend, naming boy and girl, identifying happy and sad, hearing Tt and Ii, finding number 1, circle, and red.
records.activity: Listen, tap the correct answer, and trace one letter or number.
records.question: Choose the correct greeting: Good morning or Goodbye?
records.answer: Good morning when we meet in the morning.

records.unit: Unit 2: I Can Find it at School!
records.title: Classroom Objects
records.content: Explore the classroom: classroom, teacher, chair, desk, board, book, pencil, eraser, crayon, playground, swing, and slide. Point to each object and say its name.
records.arabic: نتعرف على أشياء الفصل والملعب مثل teacher وchair وdesk وbook وpencil وswing وslide.
records.activity: Tap an object in the classroom picture to hear its English name.
records.question: Where do we learn?
records.speak: Classroom. Teacher. Chair. Desk. Book. Pencil. Playground.

records.unit: Unit 2: I Can Find it at School!
records.title: Phonics: Ss
records.content: The letter Ss has the /s/ sound. Listen and repeat: star, sun, school. Trace uppercase S and lowercase s.
records.arabic: حرف Ss يصدر صوت /s/، ومن كلماته star وsun وschool.
records.activity: Tap the star, sun, and school, then trace Ss.
records.question: Which word starts with /s/: sun or apple?
records.speak: The sound of Ss: /s/. Star. Sun. School.

records.unit: Unit 2: I Can Find it at School!
records.title: Phonics: Aa
records.content: The letter Aa has the /æ/ sound in apple and ant. Listen, repeat, and trace uppercase A and lowercase a.
records.arabic: حرف Aa يظهر في apple وant، ونستمع إلى الصوت ثم نتتبع الحرف.
records.activity: Tap the apple or ant, listen, and trace Aa.
records.question: Which word starts with Aa: ant or sun?
records.speak: The sound of Aa: /æ/. Apple. Ant.

records.unit: Unit 2: I Can Find it at School!
records.title: Phonics: Nn
records.content: The letter Nn has the /n/ sound. Listen and repeat: nest, night, numbers. Trace uppercase N and lowercase n.
records.arabic: حرف Nn يصدر صوت /n/، ومن كلماته nest وnight وnumbers.
records.activity: Tap the nest and night picture, then trace Nn.
records.question: Which word starts with /n/: nest or star?
records.speak: The sound of Nn: /n/. Nest. Night. Numbers.

records.unit: Unit 2: I Can Find it at School!
records.title: Math and Art: Number 2, Square and Blue
records.content: Recognize number 2, the square shape, and the blue color. Find two objects, touch a square, and color it blue.
records.arabic: نتعرف على العدد 2 والشكل المربع واللون الأزرق.
records.activity: Tap two objects, choose the square, and color it blue.
records.question: How many pencils do you see?
records.speak: Number two. Square. Blue.

records.unit: Unit 2: I Can Find it at School!
records.title: Asking and Answering
records.content: Practice simple questions at school. Ask: What is this? Answer: It is a book. Ask: Where is the pencil? Answer: It is on the desk. Speak clearly and listen to your friend.
records.arabic: نتدرب على السؤال والإجابة عن أدوات الفصل ونبني الثقة في الكلام والاستماع.
records.activity: Tap the object, listen to the question, and choose the matching answer.
records.question: What is this?
records.speak: What is this? It is a book. Where is the pencil? It is on the desk.

records.unit: Unit 2: I Can Find it at School!
records.title: Unit 2 Practice
records.content: Practice classroom vocabulary, the sounds Ss, Aa, and Nn, number 2, square, blue, and asking simple questions.
records.activity: Listen, find the object, tap the correct letter, and trace the square.
records.question: Which letter starts school?

records.title: My Body Parts
records.content: Name body parts: hair, face, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, teeth, arms, hands, legs, and feet. Touch the body part when you hear its name.
records.arabic: نتعرف على أجزاء الجسم ونستمع إلى الكلمة ثم نلمس الجزء الصحيح.
records.activity: Tap the body part you hear, then repeat the word in English.
records.question: What do we see with?
records.speak: Hair. Face. Eyes. Ears. Nose. Mouth. Hands. Feet.

records.title: Hygiene Actions
records.content: Take care of your body. Wash your hands, brush your teeth, take a bath, and keep your face clean. Healthy habits keep us safe and happy.
records.arabic: نتعلم عادات النظافة: غسل اليدين وتنظيف الأسنان والاستحمام والمحافظة على نظافة الوجه.
records.activity: Put the hygiene pictures in order and tap the action you hear.
records.question: What do we brush?
records.speak: Wash your hands. Brush your teeth. Keep clean.

records.title: Phonics: Pp and Hh
records.content: Pp has the /p/ sound in pen, pants, and pan. Hh has the /h/ sound in heart, honey, and helicopter. Listen, repeat, and trace both letters.
records.arabic: نتعلم صوتي Pp وHh مع كلمات pen وpants وpan وheart وhoney وhelicopter.
records.activity: Tap a picture to hear its word, sort it under Pp or Hh, then trace the letter.
records.question: Which word starts with /h/: honey or pen?
records.speak: Pp: pen, pants, pan. Hh: heart, honey, helicopter.

records.title: Phonics: Dd and Rr
records.content: Dd has the /d/ sound in dog, desk, and dress. Rr has the /r/ sound in rabbit, robot, and rice. Listen and repeat.
records.arabic: نتعلم صوتي Dd وRr مع كلمات dog وdesk وdress وrabbit وrobot وrice.
records.activity: Tap the picture, listen to the first sound, and trace Dd or Rr.
records.question: Which word starts with /r/: rabbit or dog?
records.speak: Dd: dog, desk, dress. Rr: rabbit, robot, rice.

records.title: Math and Art: Number 3, Star and Yellow
records.content: Recognize number 3, the star shape, and the yellow color. Count three objects, find a star, and color it yellow.
records.arabic: نتعرف على العدد 3 والشكل النجمي واللون الأصفر.
records.activity: Tap three objects, choose the star, and color it yellow.
records.question: How many stars do you see?
records.speak: Number three. Star. Yellow.

records.title: Unit 3 Practice
records.content: Practice body parts, hygiene actions, the sounds Pp, Hh, Dd, and Rr, number 3, star, and yellow.
records.activity: Touch the body part, choose the first letter, and trace a star.
records.question: What do we use to walk?
records.answer: We use our legs and feet.

records.title: My Family
records.content: Talk about family members: grandfather, grandmother, father, mother, sister, and brother. We can say: This is my family. I love my family.
records.arabic: نتعرف على أفراد الأسرة: grandfather وgrandmother وfather وmother وsister وbrother.
records.activity: Tap each family member and repeat the word.
records.question: Who is your mother's mother?
records.speak: Grandfather. Grandmother. Father. Mother. Sister. Brother.

records.title: Garden, Tree and Picnic Food
records.content: Learn words for a family picnic: garden, tree, flower, grass, fruit, chocolate, chips, juice, and sandwich. Choose healthy food and enjoy sharing with your family.
records.arabic: نتعرف على كلمات الحديقة والطعام، ونميز بين الطعام الصحي وغير الصحي.
records.activity: Tap the food, listen, and sort healthy food from sometimes food.
records.question: Which is a healthy picnic choice: fruit or too many chips?
records.speak: Garden. Tree. Flower. Fruit. Juice. Sandwich.

records.title: Phonics: Ee and Cc
records.content: Ee has the /e/ sound in egg, eagle, and elephant. Cc has the /k/ sound in cow, cloud, and cap. Listen, repeat, and trace.
records.arabic: نتعلم صوتي Ee وCc مع كلمات egg وeagle وelephant وcow وcloud وcap.
records.activity: Sort the pictures under Ee or Cc, listen, and trace the letters.
records.question: Which word starts with Ee: egg or cow?
records.speak: Ee: egg, eagle, elephant. Cc: cow, cloud, cap.

records.title: Phonics: Kk and Mm
records.content: Kk has the /k/ sound in kiwi, kick, and kite. Mm has the /m/ sound in mom, man, and mud. Listen and repeat.
records.arabic: نتعلم صوتي Kk وMm مع كلمات kiwi وkick وkite وmom وman وmud.
records.activity: Tap a picture, hear the first sound, and trace Kk or Mm.
records.question: Which word starts with /m/: mom or kite?
records.speak: Kk: kiwi, kick, kite. Mm: mom, man, mud.

records.title: Math and Art: Numbers 4 and 5
records.content: Review numbers 4 and 5. Recognize the heart and triangle shapes, and the green and orange colors. Count, match, and color.
records.arabic: نراجع العددين 4 و5، ونتعرف على القلب والمثلث واللونين الأخضر والبرتقالي.
records.activity: Tap four or five objects, choose the heart or triangle, then color it green or orange.
records.question: How many apples are in the group?
records.speak: Number four. Number five. Heart. Triangle. Green. Orange.

records.title: Likes and Dislikes
records.content: Express likes and dislikes politely. Say: I like fruit. I like juice. I don't like too much chocolate. Share and listen to your family.
records.arabic: نعبر عن الأشياء التي نحبها أو لا نحبها بطريقة مهذبة، ونشارك الطعام الصحي مع الأسرة.
records.activity: Tap the food and choose: I like it or I don't like it.
records.question: Complete: I ... fruit.
records.speak: I like fruit. I like juice. I don't like too much chocolate.

records.title: Term 1 Review and Classroom Project
records.content: Review greetings, classroom objects, body parts, family and picnic words. Review the sounds Tt, Ii, Ss, Aa, Nn, Pp, Hh, Dd, Rr, Ee, Cc, Kk, and Mm. Review numbers 1–5, circle, square, star, heart, triangle, and colors red, blue, yellow, green, and orange.
records.arabic: مراجعة شاملة للوحدات الأربع والمفردات والأصوات والأعداد والأشكال والألوان.
records.activity: Listen, tap, match, count, and trace. Finish the project: My Classroom or My Family Tree.
records.question: Which letter starts the word train?
records.speak: Review time! Hello, school, body, family, and picnic. Great work!

records.title: Interactive Final Practice
records.content: Activity 1: Match the word to the picture. Activity 2: Listen and choose the first sound. Activity 3: Count from 1 to 5. Activity 4: Find the shape and color. Activity 5: Say one sentence about yourself, your school, your body, or your family.
records.arabic: تدريب ختامي بالاستماع واللمس والمطابقة والعد والتحدث.
records.activity: Use the listen button, tap the answer, and trace a letter or number on the writing board.
records.question: Say one sentence: Hello, I am ...
records.answer: The child completes the sentence with their name.
